test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Hanvi starts from Point L and drives 10 km towards the north. She then takes a right turn, drives 15 km, turns right and drives 17 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 15 km. She takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point L again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

Hanvi starts from Point L.

→ Drives 10 km towards North

→ Takes a right turn and drives 15 km

→ Takes a right turn and drives 17 km

→ Takes a right turn and drives 15 km

→ Takes a final right turn and drives 2 km to reach Point P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e528900e65ec77a959db69964bcd16c4413ecfbfa4b0eb1d8a92ef00488db08.png] 

**Final Position:**

Point P is 5 km south of Point L.

So, to reach Point L again, Hanvi must travel:

→ 5 km towards North

Therefore, the shortest distance is **5 km towards north**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
